system.description:
Projecting your senses into another mind, you draw forth its very thoughts, sending or receiving concepts that both of you 'hear' inwardly. You may link with anyone you can see.

Make a Mental Challenge against the subject (a willing subject may relent) and spend a full turn in concentration. On a success you establish a link, sending a stream of thought as a single concept or plucking one truthful answer from the target — anything Aura Perception could reveal, plus names, appearances, omitted details, the truth behind a lie, or memories of a topic. Interrogating an unwilling mind requires a Mental Challenge per question. By expending a Mental Trait after linking, you may probe deeper for one of the subject's Flaws, Negative Traits or derangements (their choice), each a Static Mental Challenge the subject cannot relent to. Telepathy needs no shared language, works on only one subject at a time, and can eavesdrop invisibly on surface thoughts; forcing into an unwilling mind lets the target attempt a Willpower Challenge to break the link. Using it on a supernatural creature costs an extra Mental Trait, and it has no effect on non-sentient constructs or ordinary animals.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: As long as contact is maintained
